stem.text: Butanone, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COCH}_3$, and $\text{HCN}$ mixed with a little $\text{KCN}$ react together in a nucleophilic addition reaction.
Which description of the mechanism of this nucleophilic addition reaction is correct?

A.text: The $\pi$ bond pair of $\text{C=O}$ accepts $\text{H}^{+}$ from $\text{HCN}$ and then $\text{CN}^{-}$ acts as a nucleophile.

B.text: A $\pi$ bond pair from $\text{CN}^{-}$ attacks the $\delta^{+}$ C and $\text{HCN}$ then donates $\text{H}^{+}$ to O.

C.text: The lone pair on O accepts $\text{H}^{+}$ from $\text{HCN}$ and then $\text{CN}^{-}$ acts as a nucleophile.

D.text: A lone pair from $\text{CN}^{-}$ attacks the $\delta^{+}$ C and then $\text{O}^{-}$ accepts $\text{H}^{+}$ from $\text{HCN}$.
